summary: Implemented JSON pretty printing in the rich repo, but nothing was run, so the two new tests are unverified. Changes: JSONHighlighter in rich/highlighter.py; new rich/json.py with the JSON renderable and a main-guarded CLI; Console.print_json in rich/console.py; package-level print_json in rich/__init__.py; six json.* theme keys in rich/default_styles.py; docs (console.rst "Printing JSON" section, new reference/json.rst, reference.rst toctree entry); changelog entry under Unreleased; tests test_print_json and test_rich_print_json. Nothing committed. Caveats: the truecolor test's expected escape codes were derived by reading Style and Color code, not by running it; overflow was set to None per the spec's "none"; the CLI block imports Console, the one console dependency in rich/json.py.
